description: This file defines an interface IStorageHasherPicker which provides functionality for selecting hash functions within Orleans storage infrastructure. It includes properties and methods related to managing and choosing hashers based on various parameters.

classes.name: IStorageHasherPicker
classes.description: An interface for a picker that selects hash functions for storage purposes, supporting agility in hash function updates or replacements.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Selects an appropriate hasher based on service ID, storage provider, grain type, grain ID, grain state, and optional tag.
